changes: p2 Sūryamaṇi: added role 'owner' (copied 'ātmanaḥ pāṭhārthaṃ', i.e. for his own study), also 'paropakārārthaṃ'
Notes expanded: catalogue's 'ŚS 1790 [1709]' is unsupported by the colophon; 'saṃvat 1730' copied in Kāśī is most naturally VS (= 1674 CE for Māgha); weekday not verified

persons.name: Sūryamaṇi
persons.evidence: ilitaṃ (!) pūstakaṃ kāśyāṃ sūryamaṇidīkṣīta(!) ātmanaḥ pāṭhārthaṃ

purpose: svārtha and parārtha: ātmanaḥ pāṭhārthaṃ paropakārārthaṃ
notes: 'ilitaṃ' is an error for 'likhitaṃ'. The colophon has only 'saṃvat 1730'. Because it was copied in Kāśī, this is taken as VS 1730, which puts Māgha śukla 2 in about Jan/Feb 1674 CE. The weekday (Wednesday) was not checked. The catalogue field 'ŚS 1790 [1709] 1730' does not match the colophon, which has no Śaka date; the reading ŚS 1730 (= 1808 CE) is possible but less likely. 'prākṛtav prābamdhavyākhyāne' is corrupt and probably reads 'prākṛta-/prabandha-vyākhyāne'. Harihara is the commentator, not the scribe; 'pāṭhaka' is treated as a family or office title.
